description: NestJS Observe (telemetry-stash): requests, endpoints, DB/HTTP calls, jobs, runtime, logs, custom metrics
name: NestJS Observe

config.markdown:
### Requests
Span SERVER (mỗi request là một span gốc). Lỗi = 5xx. **Bấm một dòng trong bảng để xem trace của nó.**  [→ Mở trang Services](/services)

config.name: Requests
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count() AS requests
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)

config.name: Error rate 5xx (%)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(100 * countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)

config.name: Latency p95 (ms)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)

config.name: Failed jobs
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS failed_jobs
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Consumer' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)

config.name: Throughput theo status
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  multiIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.status_code']) >= 500, '5xx', toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.status_code']) >= 400, '4xx', '2xx/3xx') AS status,
  count() AS requests
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, status
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p50,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95,
  round(quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p99
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Endpoints
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS service,
  SpanName AS endpoint,
  count() AS calls,
  countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.status_code']) BETWEEN 400 AND 499) AS errors_4xx,
  countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors_5xx,
  round(quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
  round(max(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS max_ms
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY service, endpoint
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 100

config.markdown:
### Bên trong request
Span con do Observe ghi: method của Guard/Pipe/Service, và lời gọi ra ngoài (HTTP, DB, LLM). Bấm dòng → trace.  [→ Mở trang Services](/services)

config.name: Method chậm nhất (p95)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS service,
  SpanName AS method,
  count() AS calls,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
  round(sum(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS total_ms,
  countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Internal' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY service, method
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 30

config.name: Gọi ra ngoài (HTTP / DB)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS service,
  SpanName AS call,
  coalesce(nullIf(SpanAttributes['db.system'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['llm.provider'], ''), 'http') AS kind,
  count() AS calls,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
  countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS errors
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY service, call, kind
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 30

config.markdown:
### Jobs
Queue / cron / interval job (span CONSUMER). Bấm dòng → trace của job.

config.name: Job runs theo trạng thái
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(StatusCode = 'Error', 'failed', 'ok') AS status,
  count() AS runs
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Consumer' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, status
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Jobs
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS service,
  SpanName AS job,
  count() AS runs,
  countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS failed,
  round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms,
  max(Timestamp) AS last_run
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Consumer' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY service, job
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 50

config.markdown:
### Runtime
Runtime metrics của Observe (30s/lần), **mỗi instance một đường** — chọn Instance ở trên để xem riêng.

config.name: Heap used (MiB)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS series,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('process.memory.heap_used')
  AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: CPU (%)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS series,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('process.cpu.percent')
  AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Event loop lag (ms)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS series,
  max(Value) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('nodejs.eventloop.lag')
  AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Event loop utilization (%)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS series,
  round(100 * avg(Value), 2) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('nodejs.eventloop.utilization')
  AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: RSS (MiB)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS series,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('process.memory.rss')
  AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: GC duration theo loại (ms)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  Attributes['gc.type'] AS gc_type,
  sum(Value) AS duration_ms
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'nodejs.gc.duration_by_type' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, gc_type
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.markdown:
### Logs
Log forward từ Logger của Nest (forwardLogs). Bấm log lỗi → toàn bộ SQL của trace đó (Services › Database).

config.name: Log theo level
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  SeverityText AS level,
  count() AS logs
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, level
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Log lỗi gần nhất
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  Timestamp AS time,
  ServiceName AS service,
  LogAttributes['log.context'] AS context,
  substring(Body, 1, 300) AS message,
  TraceId AS trace_id,
  concat('TraceId = ''', TraceId, '''') AS trace_filter,
  toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) - 300000 AS from_ms,
  toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) + 300000 AS to_ms
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SeverityNumber >= 17 AND TraceId != '' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

config.markdown:
### Custom metrics
Counter / Gauge / Summary do app tự định nghĩa qua TracerService.

config.name: Counters (luỹ kế, cộng mọi instance)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, series, sum(last_value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
    concat(MetricName, if(empty(Attributes), '', concat(' ', toString(Attributes)))) AS series,
    ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance,
    argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS last_value
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND MetricName NOT LIKE 'process.%' AND MetricName NOT LIKE 'nodejs.%' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
  GROUP BY ts, series, instance
)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Gauges
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  concat(MetricName, if(empty(Attributes), '', concat(' ', toString(Attributes)))) AS series,
  avg(Value) AS value
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND MetricName NOT LIKE 'process.%' AND MetricName NOT LIKE 'nodejs.%' AND MetricName NOT LIKE '%.max' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Summaries (p95)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  concat(MetricName, if(empty(Attributes), '', concat(' ', toString(Attributes)))) AS series,
  max(ValueAtQuantiles.Value[indexOf(ValueAtQuantiles.Quantile, 0.95)]) AS p95
FROM default.otel_metrics_summary
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, series
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000

config.name: Summaries (tổng hợp)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  concat(MetricName, if(empty(Attributes), '', concat(' ', toString(Attributes)))) AS series,
  sum(Count) AS observations,
  round(sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 2) AS mean,
  max(ValueAtQuantiles.Value[indexOf(ValueAtQuantiles.Quantile, 0.95)]) AS max_p95
FROM default.otel_metrics_summary
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY series
ORDER BY observations DESC
LIMIT 50

config.name: Request chậm nhất — bấm để xem SQL của request
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH slow AS (
  SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SpanName, SpanAttributes['http.status_code'] AS status, Duration, TraceId
  FROM default.otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
  ORDER BY Duration DESC
  LIMIT 50
),
db AS (
  SELECT TraceId, count() AS queries, sum(Duration) AS db_ns
  FROM default.otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['db.system'] != ''
    AND TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM slow)
  GROUP BY TraceId
)
SELECT
  slow.Timestamp AS time,
  slow.ServiceName AS service,
  slow.SpanName AS endpoint,
  slow.status AS status,
  round(slow.Duration / 1e6, 1) AS duration_ms,
  coalesce(db.queries, 0) AS db_queries,
  round(coalesce(db.db_ns, 0) / 1e6, 1) AS db_ms,
  slow.TraceId AS trace_id,
  concat('TraceId = ''', slow.TraceId, '''') AS trace_filter,
  toUnixTimestamp64Milli(slow.Timestamp) - 60000 AS from_ms,
  toUnixTimestamp64Milli(slow.Timestamp) + intDiv(slow.Duration, 1000000) + 60000 AS to_ms
FROM slow
LEFT JOIN db ON db.TraceId = slow.TraceId
ORDER BY slow.Duration DESC
LIMIT 50

config.markdown:
### Instances
Đang chạy = gửi runtime metrics trong 90 giây gần nhất (mỗi process gửi 30s/lần, kể cả khi rảnh). Không phụ thuộc khung thời gian đang chọn.

config.name: Đang chạy theo service (90s gần nhất)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS service,
  uniqExact(if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) AS instances,
  arrayStringConcat(arraySort(arrayFilter(r -> r != '', arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(splitByChar(',', ResourceAttributes['observe.roles'])))))), ', ') AS roles
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 90 SECOND
  AND MetricName = 'process.cpu.percent' AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY service
LIMIT 100

config.name: Instances (trong khung thời gian đang chọn)
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH rt AS (
  SELECT
    ServiceName AS service,
    if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS instance,
    max(TimeUnix) AS last_seen,
    min(TimeUnix) AS first_seen,
    any(ResourceAttributes['observe.source.ip']) AS ip,
    groupArray(splitByChar(',', ResourceAttributes['observe.roles'])) AS path_roles,
    round(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'process.memory.heap_used'), 1) AS heap_mib,
    round(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'process.memory.rss'), 1) AS rss_mib,
    round(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'process.cpu.percent'), 1) AS cpu_pct,
    round(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'nodejs.eventloop.lag'), 1) AS loop_lag_ms
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
  GROUP BY service, instance
),
jobs AS (
  -- dự phòng: role từ tag của job (app chưa gắn /r/<roles> vào endpoint)
  SELECT ServiceName AS service, if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS instance,
    groupUniqArray(SpanAttributes['role']) AS job_roles
  FROM default.otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Consumer' AND SpanAttributes['role'] != '' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
  GROUP BY service, instance
)
SELECT
  if(rt.last_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 90 SECOND, '🟢 running', '⚪ stopped') AS status,
  rt.service AS service,
  rt.instance AS instance,
  arrayStringConcat(arraySort(arrayFilter(r -> r != '', arrayDistinct(arrayConcat(arrayFlatten(rt.path_roles), arrayFlatten(arrayMap(x -> splitByChar(',', x), jobs.job_roles)))))), ', ') AS roles,
  rt.last_seen AS last_seen,
  rt.first_seen AS first_seen,
  rt.heap_mib AS heap_mib,
  rt.rss_mib AS rss_mib,
  rt.cpu_pct AS cpu_pct,
  rt.loop_lag_ms AS loop_lag_ms,
  rt.ip AS ip
FROM rt
LEFT JOIN jobs ON jobs.service = rt.service AND jobs.instance = rt.instance
ORDER BY status, service, instance
LIMIT 500

config.name: Số instance theo thời gian
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} second) AS ts,
  ServiceName AS service,
  uniqExact(if(empty(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']), ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) AS instances
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'process.cpu.percent' AND ScopeName = '@nestjs/observe' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], $instance)
GROUP BY ts, service
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 10000
